description: This file contains utility functions used for network interface management, process identification, and service control, primarily related to DHCP server utilities. It includes functions for executing system commands, retrieving MAC and IP addresses of interfaces, checking interface presence, locating process IDs by name, and controlling service states via sys events.

methods.name: int vsystem(const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Executes a formatted system command and logs it.

methods.name: int iface_get_hwaddr(const char * ifname,char * mac,size_t size)
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware (MAC) address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: int iface_get_ipv4addr(const char * ifname,char * ipv4Addr,size_t size)
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address assigned to a specified network interface.

methods.name: int is_iface_present(const char * ifname)
methods.description: Checks if a specified network interface is present on the system.

methods.name: int pid_of(const char * name,const char * keyword)
methods.description: Finds the PID of a process by name and optionally filtering by keyword.

methods.name: int serv_can_start(int sefd,token_t setok,const char * servname)
methods.description: Determines if a service can be started based on its sys event status.

methods.name: int serv_can_stop(int sefd,token_t setok,const char * servname)
methods.description: Determines if a service can be stopped based on its sys event status.

ctags.name: serv_can_start
ctags.pattern: /^int serv_can_start(int sefd, token_t setok, const char *servname)$/

ctags.name: serv_can_stop
ctags.pattern: /^int serv_can_stop(int sefd, token_t setok, const char *servname)$/
